newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
At least a dozen villages were flooded in Feni district on Wednesday in a flash flood caused by onrush of waters from across the border.
At least six people have so far died in the country and 80 others affected with HIV virus, Health Minister Salahuddin Yusuf said on Wednesday.
The visiting former Indian Union Minister K.C. Pant on Wednesday said the Bangladesh-India water sharing treaty would "certainly" be honoured.
High Court on Wednesday declared that the recent eviction of sex-workers from a brothel in Dhaka was illegal and violation of basic human rights.
The flame of the Magurchhara gas field fire further decreased on Wednesday.
Bangladesh imported goods worth Taka 111.38 billion from India during 1991-96 while its exports to India amounted Tk 5.9 billion during the period.
A total of 2.08,529 Bangladeshis were employed abroad from July 1996 to May 1997, State Minister for Labour and Manpower Abdul Mannan told the parliament on Wednesday.
Former Finance Minister M.A. Muhit said the 1997/98 budget was not liberalisation friendly. REUTER
